programmes.title: Bible Translation & Literacy
programmes.seoTitle: Bible Translation & Literacy | Relief South Sudan
programmes.tagline: Making God’s Word accessible to every language community.
programmes.need: South Sudan is home to diverse language communities, many of which have limited access to Scripture and literacy resources in their own languages.
programmes.response: Through our Bible Translation and Literacy programme, we support efforts to make God’s Word accessible, understandable and relevant to local communities.
activities: Bible translation into South Sudanese languages
programmes.outcome: We believe that people should have the opportunity to encounter and understand God’s Word in a language they know and understand.

programmes.title: Trauma Healing, Psychosocial Support & Peacebuilding
programmes.seoTitle: Trauma Healing & Peacebuilding | Relief South Sudan
programmes.tagline: Helping communities heal, rebuild and live in peace.
programmes.need: Conflict, displacement, violence and loss have left many individuals and communities experiencing trauma and emotional distress.
programmes.response: Our programmes provide community-based opportunities for healing, reconciliation and psychosocial support.
programmes.outcome: We seek to create safe spaces where individuals and communities can heal, rebuild relationships and develop hope for the future.
programmes.imageRule: Wide shots only — no identifiable participants.

programmes.title: Church Leadership & Discipleship
programmes.seoTitle: Church Leadership & Discipleship | Relief South Sudan
programmes.need: Strong and servant-hearted Christian leadership is essential for healthy churches and transformed communities.
programmes.response: Relief South Sudan supports pastors, church leaders and emerging leaders through training, mentorship and capacity development.
programmes.outcome: We seek to equip local leaders with the knowledge, skills and values required to serve their churches and communities effectively.

programmes.title: Girls’ Empowerment & Protection
programmes.seoTitle: Girls’ Empowerment & Protection | Relief South Sudan
programmes.tagline: Creating opportunities for girls to learn, grow and thrive.
programmes.need: Girls and young women face significant barriers to education, safety, economic opportunity and participation in community life.
programmes.response: Our Girls’ Initiative seeks to empower girls with knowledge, confidence, skills and opportunities while working with communities to address harmful practices and protection concerns.
activities: Support and referral for vulnerable girls
programmes.outcome: We believe every girl deserves the opportunity to grow up safe, educated, empowered and hopeful.
programmes.imageAlt: An empty classroom desk with open exercise books, a pencil and a school bag
programmes.imageRule: Illustration only (AI-generated, no people). Never show identifiable girls.

programmes.title: Water, Sanitation & Hygiene (WASH)
programmes.seoTitle: Water, Sanitation & Hygiene (WASH) | Relief South Sudan
programmes.tagline: Improving access to safe water and healthier communities.
programmes.need: Access to safe water, sanitation and hygiene is fundamental to health, dignity and community development.
programmes.response: Relief South Sudan works with communities to improve access to safe water and strengthen sustainable community management of water resources.
programmes.outcome: We work with communities to ensure that water facilities are appropriately managed, maintained and sustained for long-term benefit.
programmes.imageAlt: Clean water pouring from a tap into a yellow jerrycan

programmes.title: Women Empowerment & Livelihoods
programmes.seoTitle: Women Empowerment & Livelihoods | Relief South Sudan
programmes.tagline: Strengthening women and families through opportunity and economic empowerment.
programmes.cardLine: Strengthening women and families through economic opportunity.
programmes.need: Women are central to the wellbeing and resilience of families and communities. Yet many women face limited access to financial resources, skills, markets and economic opportunities.
programmes.response: Our Women Empowerment programmes support women to develop skills, strengthen livelihoods and participate more actively in household and community decision-making.
programmes.outcome: We seek to help women build sustainable livelihoods that contribute to stronger families and more resilient communities.
programmes.imageAlt: A treadle sewing machine with folded printed fabric, a tape measure and scissors
